style: Square editorial still-life photograph, shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens at f/2.8, soft natural window light, rustic weathered wooden table and coarse undyed linen, shallow depth of field, true-to-life colours, subtle film grain, natural imperfections, calm earthy mood of a mountain village. No text, no labels, no logos, no people. Not over-saturated, not glossy, not CGI.
how: Generate one image per product with subject + ' ' + style, put the full-size download link in sources.json and push; the product-photos-import workflow does the rest. Links expire after 2 hours.
